title: Chilli Garlic Oil
description: A fragrant Asian condiment — fiery, aromatic, and incredibly versatile. Elevates everything it touches.

method.instruction: Heat vegetable oil in a small saucepan over low heat.
Add minced garlic and cook gently until lightly golden, about 3–4 minutes. Do not let it brown or it will turn bitter.
Add chilli flakes, salt, soy sauce, and sugar. Stir for 1–2 minutes until fragrant.
Remove from heat and allow to cool completely.
Transfer to a clean jar. Store in the refrigerator for up to 1 month.

notes.title: Serving Tip
notes.content: Drizzle over noodles, dumplings, or rice. Spoon over eggs, stir-fries, or grilled meats for an instant flavour boost.

notes.title: Garlic Care
notes.content: Keep the heat low when cooking garlic. If it burns, start again — burnt garlic makes the oil bitter and unusable.
